prompts.keyframe: Photoreal cinematic film still. two vast ancient Indian armies facing each other across the plain of Kurukshetra, banners raised, chariots in the front ranks, figures small against the sun. Identity: Kurukshetra battlefield at dawn: two vast armies facing each other, saffron and white banners, conches, dust and haze, sun rising between them. Kurukshetra battlefield at dawn: two vast ancient Indian armies facing each other across an open plain, saffron and white banners, chariots and elephants, dust and haze, the sun rising low between them. wide composed for a widescreen frame: wide frame layered in depth: foreground silhouetted spear tips and banners, middle ground ranks of soldiers and chariots, background the low sun between the armies. This is the first frame of the shot, framed as a subject on one third. camera at eye level. 100-135 mm equivalent lens: compressed, stacked layers, elegant controlled composition, soft background, minimal perspective distortion. depth of field around f/2.8, deep focus: foreground to horizon readable; a deliberate focal hierarchy, not blur everywhere. low golden sun just above the horizon behind and slightly to the side of the subject; warm amber light, long shadows, bright rim highlights on hair, armour, cloth and edges, gradual falloff; soft warm bounce from the ground keeps the shadow side readable. dense golden dust and haze, fine dust and haze catching the light. richly detailed saffron and white silk banners, bronze armour, wooden chariot wheels. grade: photoreal cinematic CGI of an Indian epic, golden-hour backlight, sun low in frame, volumetric haze and dust, warm rim light on skin and metal, shallow depth of field, anamorphic flare, heroic scale; exposure deep crushed blacks (5th-percentile luma ~11/255), bright creamy highlights (95th ~222), mid-tones low (~82); warm amber highlights, earthy midtones, controlled deep shadows, natural skin, never uniformly orange. the image character of a modern large-format digital cinema camera: filmic highlight roll-off, wide dynamic range, natural colour separation, smooth skin tones, rich shadow detail, fine organic texture and natural 180-degree-shutter motion blur.

prompts.video: Lateral tracking (slider): camera slides sideways parallel to the subject, from subject on one third to subject held on the same third, slow, matched to the subject's walking pace, smooth acceleration and deceleration; camera slides slowly left to right parallel to the front ranks; compressed telephoto perspective. Keep foreground passes faster than the background; constant subject scale. No sliding through objects, inconsistent parallax. Banners ripple in the wind; dust drifts across the ranks; horses shift their weight. dense golden dust and haze, fine dust and haze catching the light. lighting and shadows stay consistent with the first frame: low golden sun just above the horizon behind and slightly to the side of the subject; warm amber light, long shadows, bright rim highlights on hair, armour, cloth and edges, gradual falloff; soft warm bounce from the ground keeps the shadow side readable. photographic rather than synthetic; tactile textures with fine pores, threads, metal wear and dust; physically plausible light and shadow; all motion obeys weight, gravity and inertia with solid ground contact; stable identity, anatomy, costume and jewellery throughout the shot; stable background geometry; consistent light direction from first to last frame. the shot settles on: the sun flares between two banners, cut on the flare.
